description: Re-scan the finding's file (or explicit paths) with the deterministic rules and report whether the same fingerprint is still present. Useful after a fix.

findingId.description: Finding ID (VGL-...), fingerprint (fp_...) or a unique prefix.

line.description: Line number within path. Omit to match the only finding on that path.

path.description: Repository-relative path of the finding; use with line instead of findingId.

paths.description: Files to re-scan, relative to the scan root. Defaults to the finding's file.

scanId.description: Scan the finding belongs to. Defaults to the most recent scan.

name: vigil_verify
title: Verify that a Vigil finding is gone
